name: long-incident-page
note: About 6,000 tokens; split into parts and merged.

turns.text: When PagerDuty triggers an incident, enrich it with recent deploys and post to #incidents. High urgency only.

Iteration 1 of the draft:

```yaml
name: incident-page
on:
  pagerduty.incident:
    events: [triggered]
steps:
  - id: enrich
    image: ghcr.io/acme/incident-enricher@sha256:3f1c0e0b8d0a1c3b2a6f4e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b
    with:
      service: ${{ trigger.incident.service.name }}
      urgency: ${{ trigger.incident.urgency }}
  - id: notify
    uses: slack.post_message
    with:
      channel: "#incidents"
      text: "${{ trigger.incident.title }} (${{ trigger.incident.urgency }})"
```
